punchline: A therapist spent years telling patients their feelings need not match what they should be, then heard it from her own therapist.
thirty_sec: When her boyfriend left because he would not live with her young son, therapist Lori Gottlieb booked a few sessions with Wendell. She cried through the first ones. Then he told her that her feelings did not have to match what she thought they should be. It was a line she had said to patients for years, and from the other chair it sounded new.
